goal: Let external kernel consumers trace intermediate script execution states
Enable step-by-step script debuggers, visualizers, and finer test inspection
agreement: Mild consensus with general support for the concept and functionality
Extensively verified via C API over tens of thousands of spends (fametrano)
Tested using Python bindings and a visualizer with no issues found (elmeriniemela)
Concept approval citing testing benefits (furszy, w0xlt, theStack)
